conclusion: No defensible deploy-safety finding. This is an internal per-run coordinator and local plugin, with source pinning and explicit human-directed mid-run definition switches rather than a rolling deployed service fleet. Persistent recovery and approvals records are additive and append-only; changed cleanup helpers retain resources for unavailable inspection. Lack of general old/new mixed process support is not independently a concrete regression in this lane.
source_policy: Frozen Git objects exported to owned evidence directory; no caller workspace mutations and no mutation-capable product commands executed.
